ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast discrepancy between dominant low-intensity (dark grey/black) fluke surface and sparse high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark-field pigmentation; high-intensity white punctate spots are clustered in the lower-medial and right-medial regions; three distinct diagonal high-intensity linear marks are situated on the upper-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp apical convergence and high bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary along the entire trailing edge with prominent peaks and valleys isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge leading from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast pixel clusters distributed across the right-medial ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of unaligned, parallel diagonal white linear streaks on the upper-left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, textured, high-intensity protruding masses consistent with barnacle colonization located on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
